services.name: Pontoon Boat Private Charter
services.desc: Duration 2 and 4 Hours About Come aboard our large pontoon boat for a private tour of Lake Tahoe for up to 10 passengers. Our tour is a perfect blend of comfort, activities, and sightseeing. Guests will enjoy seeing Emerald Bay State Park and D.L. Bliss State Park, paddle boarding, tubing, swimming, and relaxing with friends and family in beautiful bays and coves on our comfortable and spacious boat. Our tours are unique because of all the activities we include on the tour and our attention to detail for photos and videos. Please note: Tubing will not be available with more than 8 passengers.
